title: Vampire Vape Desserts Pistachio Milkshake 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Pistachio Milkshake by Vampire Vape Desserts Koncept range offers a luxurious blend of roasted Pistachio flavour stirred through a smooth, velvety Milkshake base. This indulgent vape captures the nutty richness of Pistachio, mellowed by the cool creaminess of a classic milkshake drink, for an expertly layered and comforting flavour experience. Blended at 70% VG to 30% PG, this high-VG shortfill is made for sub-ohm vape kits, delivering thick vapour and immersive flavour. Each bottle contains 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 120ml bottle, with space to add two 10ml nicotine shots if desired. Crafted in the UK to the highest standards, Pistachio Milkshake is part of the Vampire Vape Desserts range — a range of sweet, comforting e-liquid blends inspired by classic dessert and beverage flavours. Also available in Freebase 10mls and Concentrates for DIY mixing.
